summary: Cursor effects (custom cursor, cursor trail, follow pointer, click spark, magnetic).

components.name: BlobCursor-TS-TW
components.title: Blob Cursor
components.blurb: Custom cursor appears as a smooth blob following pointer movement.

components.name: ClickSpark-TS-TW
components.title: Click Spark
components.blurb: Sparks burst outward from each click on the canvas.

components.name: Crosshair-TS-TW
components.title: Crosshair Cursor
components.blurb: Custom crosshair cursor with horizontal and vertical lines tracking the pointer.

components.name: GhostCursor-TS-TW
components.title: Ghost Cursor Trail
components.blurb: A luminous trail that follows your cursor and fades when you stop moving.

components.name: ImageTrail-TS-TW
components.title: Image Cursor Trail
components.blurb: Images follow your cursor in a smooth, staggered trail.

components.name: Magnet-TS-TW
components.title: Magnet Effect
components.blurb: Wraps children that lean toward the cursor within a radius, easing back to rest.

components.name: PixelTrail-TS-TW
components.title: Pixel Cursor Trail
components.blurb: Pixelated cursor trail that fades and dissipates with configurable grid…

components.name: Ribbons-TS-TW
components.title: Physics Ribbon Trail
components.blurb: Colored ribbons trail the cursor with spring physics.

components.name: SplashCursor-TS-TW
components.title: Fluid Splash Cursor
components.blurb: Fluid ink simulation that responds to cursor movement and clicks.

components.name: TargetCursor-TS-TW
components.title: Target Lock Cursor
components.blurb: Spinning reticle cursor that locks onto hover targets.

components.name: TextCursor-TS-TW
components.title: Text Cursor Trail
components.blurb: Text characters trail behind the cursor with motion physics.

components.name: following-pointer
components.title: Custom Cursor Follower
components.blurb: Custom pointer with label follows cursor within a bounded area.

components.name: magnetic-button
components.title: Magnetic Button
components.blurb: Leans toward the cursor, springs back on release.

components.name: sleek-line-cursor
components.title: Sleek Line Cursor
components.blurb: Colorful trailing lines follow the cursor with spring physics.

components.name: smooth-cursor
components.title: Smooth Cursor
components.blurb: Custom cursor that smoothly follows the mouse and rotates with velocity.

components.name: tailed-cursor
components.title: Tailed Cursor
components.blurb: Multicolored WebGL-powered cursor trail with spring physics.
